stories.title: Flintshire County Council files demolition notice for what remains of County Hall in Mold
stories.summary: What remains of County Hall in Mold is set to be demolished next year, with Flintshire County Council saying it is too early to say what will replace it. stories.title: Safety first as councillor tells Flintshire residents with on-street parking not to buy electric cars
stories.summary: Flintshire’s Cabinet Member for the Environment has advised residents not to purchase electric cars if they can’t charge them. stories.title: Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board sees increase in “never events”
stories.summary: The number of “never events” has increased within Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board over the past 12 months.
